An Iron Heart Part I#007.src: Oh, you there! I wasn't expecting a human soldier to be here, but you've come at a perfect time. I could use some help, see.
An Iron Heart Part I#007.dst: ¡Oh, oye, tú! No esperaba ver aquí a un soldado humano, pero llegas en el momento perfecto. Me vendría bien ayuda.
An Iron Heart Part I#007.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#008.src: I'm certain you know about Guard Golems, yes? They're manufactured here in Gavel, and I bought one recently.
An Iron Heart Part I#008.dst: Conoces los Gólems guardianes, ¿verdad? Se fabrican aquí en Gavel, y hace poco compré uno.
An Iron Heart Part I#008.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#009.src: The goblins keep trying to forage in my farms, you see- I needed something to keep them out, and a Golem would have been perfect.
An Iron Heart Part I#009.dst: Verás, los goblins no paran de rebuscar en mis granjas- necesitaba algo para echarlos, y un gólem habría sido perfecto.
An Iron Heart Part I#009.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#010.src: But, shortly after I activated it, the thing attacked me! I nearly got killed- It was ramming itself against boulders and walls...
An Iron Heart Part I#010.dst: Pero, poco después de activarlo, ¡la cosa me atacó! Casi me mata- Se lanzaba contra rocas y paredes...
An Iron Heart Part I#010.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#011.src: I obviously was sold a defective model... That golem is a danger to everything around it. Do you think you're up to subduing it?
An Iron Heart Part I#011.dst: Está claro que me vendieron un modelo defectuoso... Ese gólem es un peligro para todo lo que lo rodea. ¿Te ves capaz de reducirlo?
An Iron Heart Part I#011.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#012.src: It's shed a trail of scrap, as you can see. Please, follow the trail of scrap and keep it from causing anyone more damage!
An Iron Heart Part I#012.dst: Ha dejado un rastro de chatarra, como ves. Por favor, sigue el rastro y evita que haga más daño a nadie.
An Iron Heart Part I#012.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#013.src: Find the defective Guard Golem in the mountain at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
An Iron Heart Part I#013.dst: Encuentra el Gólem guardián defectuoso en la montaña en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

An Iron Heart Part I#021.dst: Reduce al Gólem guardián defectuoso y vuelve con Duvale en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

An Iron Heart Part I#023.src: Were you able to subdue the golem? You certainly look like you're in one piece.
An Iron Heart Part I#023.dst: ¿Has podido reducir al gólem? Desde luego pareces estar de una pieza.
An Iron Heart Part I#023.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#024.src: Ach...that stings. I shouldn't be surprised you had to destroy it, but that was still a big wasted investment for me.
An Iron Heart Part I#024.dst: Ay... qué rabia. No debería sorprenderme que tuvieras que destruirlo, pero ha sido una inversión tirada a la basura.
An Iron Heart Part I#024.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#025.src: Still, it makes me wonder...it sounded like it was talking when I first turned it on- Wait, you heard it too?
An Iron Heart Part I#025.dst: Aun así, me hace pensar... parecía que hablaba cuando lo encendí- Espera, ¿tú también lo oíste?
An Iron Heart Part I#025.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#026.src: Hm. There are some unsavory rumors about the factory, come to think of it... Maybe there's some stock to them.
An Iron Heart Part I#026.dst: Mmm. Ahora que lo pienso, corren rumores feos sobre la fábrica... Quizá tengan algo de cierto.
An Iron Heart Part I#026.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#027.src: It said a name? Madeleine? It doesn't exactly ring a bell, but that's...rather concerning. I never mentioned a Madeleine to it.
An Iron Heart Part I#027.dst: ¿Dijo un nombre? ¿Madeleine? No me suena de nada, pero eso es... bastante preocupante. Nunca le mencioné a ninguna Madeleine.
An Iron Heart Part I#027.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#028.src: This is worth sending onto the police, really. I think I might have to write to {p}- the factory is near there.
An Iron Heart Part I#028.dst: Esto merece llegar a la policía, la verdad. Creo que tendré que escribir a {p}- la fábrica está cerca de allí.
An Iron Heart Part I#028.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#029.src: Til then, here. Consider this your reward for helping me out, brave Human. Good luck out there.
An Iron Heart Part I#029.dst: Hasta entonces, toma. Considéralo tu recompensa por ayudarme, valiente humano. Buena suerte ahí fuera.
An Iron Heart Part I#029.speaker: Duvale
